verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a hosted search service. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence shows the core search index or API can be deployed on your own infrastructure. Every doc describes calling Brave's hosted endpoints with an API key. The open-source MCP server is a client-side wrapper around the hosted API, and Open WebUI and Dify are self-hosted third-party platforms. Neither makes the core product self-hostable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
